title: Assessment of the application for modification of the terms of authorisation of the feed additive consisting of lanthanum carbonate octahydrate (4d23) for cats and dogs (Porus GmbH)
text:
published: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:32:20 +0100 Assessment of the application for modification of the terms of authorisation of the feed additive consisting of lanthanum carbonate octahydrate (4d23) for cats and dogs (Porus GmbH)

Following a request from the European Commission, EFSA was asked to deliver a scientific opinion on the modification of the terms of authorisation of the feed additive consisting of lanthanum carbonate octahydrate for cats and dogs. The additive is currently authorised as a zootechnical additive for use in feed for adult cats and dogs with minimum and maximum use levels of 1500 and 7500 mg/kg complete feed, respectively. The applicant requested that the authorisation be modified to allow the additive to be mixed directly into feed by pet holders immediately before consumption.
